def aff(p, n='v', rob=False):
    a = np.c_[np.ones(len(p['u'])), p['u']]
    v = p[n]
    w = np.ones(len(a))
    for i in range(15 if rob else 1):
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(a * w[:, None], v * w[:, None], rcond=None)[0]
        e = np.linalg.norm(a @ b - v, axis=1)
        w = np.minimum(1, 2 * np.median(e) / np.maximum(e, 1e-12))
    return b

def fitpred(K, H, T, tr, te, alpha):
    from scipy.linalg import solve
    G = K[np.ix_(tr, tr)] + alpha * np.eye(len(tr))
    D = H[tr]
    W = solve(G, np.column_stack((D, T[tr])), assume_a='pos')
    n = D.shape[1]
    b = np.linalg.lstsq(D.T @ W[:, :n], D.T @ W[:, n:], rcond=1e-10)[0]
    return H[te] @ b + K[np.ix_(te, tr)] @ (W[:, n:] - W[:, :n] @ b)

def pred(k, reg, f, ya, tr, te):
    from scipy.linalg import solve
    a = k[np.ix_(tr, tr)] + reg * np.eye(len(tr))
    c = k[np.ix_(te, tr)]
    h = f[tr]
    r = solve(a, np.c_[h, ya[tr]], assume_a='pos')
    (w, v) = (r[:, :h.shape[1]], r[:, h.shape[1]:])
    b = np.linalg.lstsq(h.T @ w, h.T @ v, rcond=1e-12)[0]
    return f[te] @ b + c @ (v - w @ b)
